title: Understanding the Model Equation
text: The model equation given is $$self_{rating}=\theta_0+\theta_1 critic_1$$. This equation is used to predict the $$self_{rating}$$ based on $$critic_{1's}$$ rating.

title: Effect of Subtracting the Mean
text: Subtracting the mean from $$self_{rating}$$ will change the values of $$self_{rating}$$ but will not affect the relationship between $$self_{rating}$$ and $$critic_1$$ in the model equation.

title: Impact on $$\theta_1$$
text: The parameter $$\theta_1$$ represents the change in $$self_{rating}$$ for a one-unit change in $$critic_1$$. Subtracting the mean from $$self_{rating}$$ does not change this relationship.
